Commentary.Commentary: 310 is the target then for Bangladesh. It will be interesting to see whether dew comes into play. That might make the ball skid onto the bat. Still, a very good score to defend. Join us back at 1245 GMT (1815 IST) for the second innings.

A poor bowling display by Bangladesh overall. Strange captaincy from Mortaza, not giving Taskin his full quota of overs. Shakib started well but ended up on the expensive side. The fielding let the bowlers down big time.

Stokes and debutant Duckett got together and added 153 for the fourth wicket and that put pressure on the hosts. Two catches were put down, both of Stokes and he made them pay. Duckett was excellent at the other end, not losing his cool at all. Even after the duo was dismissed, Bangladesh could not recover as Buttler came in and hammered 63 from just 38 balls, which catapulted the score past 300.

That is a handy total on this track by England. They got off to a decent start but then lost their way in the middle. From 41/0 they slipped to 63/3 and the hosts were right back in the game. But then in came the two Bens and changed the momentum.

OUT! Darts in a yorker at the stumps, Willey does well to dig it out back towards Shakib. He turns around and hurls in a direct hit at the non striker's end. To be sure, he picks up the ball and throws it towards Rahim who flicks off the bails. The appeal for the run out is referred upstairs and the replays confirm that Woakes was short of his crease.
I missed it but DAVID WILLEY came in after Buttler's dismissal.
Woakes comes down the track to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards mid off for a quick single.

OUT! Not quite three sixes! Intelligent stuff from Shakib. Bowls a wide full toss, Buttler has to reach out for it and only manages to hit it down the throat of Mosaddek at long off who complets an easy catch.
Three balls left... three sixes?

2 Leg byes. Slow through the air and fullish on off, Buttler comes down and looks to flick it but misses and is rapped on the pads. The ball rolls towards the short third man region and the batsmen take a couple.
Slow through the air, Buttler goes for a slog but misses and it strikes the pad of Rahim and rolls towards the leg side. The batsmen come through for a bye.
Low full toss outside off, Buttler pushes it through the covers for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to bowl the 50th over.

TOP EDGE! SAFE! Shortish delivery, Woakes stands tall and tries to pull it but gets a top edge towards the mid-wicket region as he is not in control with that one. Two fielders come running in towards the ball but there is no communication between them and the ball falls in no man's land. The batsmen choose not to run.
A change of pace this time, Buttler flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Wide full toss outside off, Buttler throws his hands at this one and the ball catches the top edge of his bat and goes just over the third man boundary.
A length ball down the leg side, CW looks to work it to the leg side but misses. The ball goes off his hips towards square leg and the batsmen take a single. A leg bye taken.
A yorker now, outside off, Chris looks to steer it to third man but misses. The players appeal for a catch but there was no wood in it.
FOUR! A short ball wide outside off, Woakes backs away and slaps it over point for a boundary!
Okay... so TASKIN AHMED will bowl at least one over in the last 10.
11th ODI Fifty for Buttler! What a finishing touch. Off just 33 balls. Excellent knock.
SIX! That's whacked! Full length delivery outside off, Buttler sits down and hits it over long off for a maximum. 50 up for Buttler and it has been a great knock. 19 runs from the over.
FOUR! Shortish in length, Buttler swivels across and pulls it through square leg and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length ball, Buttler rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short ball, Buttler pulls it uppishly towards long leg for a couple. The fielder from the boundary comes in but can't reach the ball and the batsmen come through for a couple.
Yorker that is well driected, Buttler digs it out through mid-wicket and scampers through for a brisk couple.
Fullish delivery outside off, Woakes drives it through covers for a single.
TASKIN AHMED eventually comes on to bowl. Strange from Mortaza, this guy won't be bowling his full quota. Change of mind from the captain. SHAFIUL ISLAM gets the ball back.
SIX! Handsome shot! Flighted delivery, Buttler comes down the track and lifts it over long on for a maximum.
SIX! Lovely shot! Tossed up around leg stump, Buttler has his dancing shoes on and hits a meaty blow over widish long on and the ball clears the boundary easily.
Straying on the pads, nudged towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around off, Buttler tries to go inside out again but only manages to get it through the covers for a single.
Expertly played! Tossed up around middle and off, Woakes makes room and lofts it over the covers with soft hands and comes through for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Back of a length ball outside off, Woakes glides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! The placement was spot on! Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, Woakes makes room and lifts it beautifully over the covers and the ball races to the boundary.
Full length delivery outside off, Buttler creams it through the covers for a single.
Very full outside off, squeezed behind point for a single. 250 up for England.
Shafiul Islam back into the attack.
Quick through the air outside off, Woakes stays back and punches it through covers for a single.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, punched down to long off for a run.
Full and outside off, Buttler jumps down the track and blasts it down to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
CHRIS WOAKES walks in at number 8, replacing Moeen.

OUT! Ali departs and the short ball ploy has worked! Dug in short, Ali gets into position early and pulls it towards fine leg. Tamim Iqbal who is stationed there doesn't have to move an inch and completes a comfortable catch.
Straying on the pads, worked behind square leg for a couple.
Bouncer! Dug in short, Ali swivels across and goes for the pull but misses and the ball zips through to the keeper.
Fullish delivery around middle and leg, Ali clips it wide of mid on and comes back for a couple.
On a length outside off, played with an angled bat towards point for a brisk single.

Fullish delivery around off and a change of pace perhaps. Buttler shuffles across and works it towards square leg who puts in a good effort and hurls in a throw at the non striker's end hitting the stumps but Buttler is safely in. There is no one to back up and as a result he concedes an extra run.
Full around middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Buttler drives it with the angle through mid on and comes back for a quick couple.
Quick through the air and lands it on a length on middle, Buttler rocks back and punches it through mid-wicket for a couple.
A tad short outside off, cut towards point for no run.
Similar delivery, Buttler defends with a straight bat.
Quick through to the air on middle, Buttler stays back and defends.
SHAKIB AL HASAN comes back on.
Straying on the hips, Ali tickles it nicely round the corner for a couple.
Fullish delivery, driven towards mid off for a brisk single.
On a length outside off, pushed towards the covers.
MOEEN ALI walks in at number 7, replacing Stokes.

OUT! Stokes departs after a superb knock and it is the skipper who removes him! Shortish delivery directed at the stumps, Stokes stands tall and pulls it powerfully and aerially over mid-wicket but is unfortunate to have hit it straight down the throat of Sabbir Rahman at deep mid-wicket. He makes no mistake and grabs it comfortably.
Straying on the pads, worked behind square for a single.

Fullish delivery around off, Stokes drives it with soft hands towards mid on and calls for a two straightaway. Completes the single quickly but the fielder from  long on sprints in and keeps it down to a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Buttles drives on the up towards deep cover for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! A tad short on off, Buttler shuffles across and flicks it behind square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Maiden ODI hundred for Ben Stokes. It has been such a wonder to watch. He is soaked in sweat. He is tired and famished but has played well.

100 up for Stokes and it has been a superb knock! On a length angling into Stokes. He stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket. He is delighted and lifts his hands in the air. The English dressing room is all smiles and appreciate the knock. He has put England in a great position!
Back of a length ball, chopped towards point.
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Straying on the pads, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
On a length directed at the stumps, Stokes stays back and defends.
Mid on drops back to long on now...
Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, played with soft hands towards mid on and they steal a single there.
On a length angling into Buttler. He covers the line and pushes it towards short extra cover.
On a length around middle, punched towards long on for a single. He moves on to 99 with that.
Dug in short around middle, Buttler is in two minds as he looks to duck under it but decides to pull it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Skipper JOS BUTTLER walks in at number 6, replacing Duckett. He has already got form on this trip, with a century in the warm-up game.

OUT! Duckett departs after a brilliant knock! He pre-meditates on this occasion and sets himself up to play the paddle by going across his stumps. Islam picks it up and bowls a full toss on leg stump. Duckett is not able to reach it and the ball crashes into the base of the leg stump. Good thinking by the bowler and he gets rewarded!
Good change of pace by Islam. On a length angled across Duckett. He made room and went for the inside out shot but is beaten by the intelligent change in pace.
Full length delivery at the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Fullish delivery, Stokes goes for the paddle but only manages to get it through to the fielder at short fine leg for a single.
On a length on off, Stokes stays back and punches it to long on for a single.
Full length delivery fired in at the stumps, Stokes strides forward and defends.
SHAFIUL ISLAM comes back on.
Slower delivery this time, Duckett goes for the pull but is beaten by the pace and the ball goes over the stumps and on a bounce to the keeper
Similar length delivery, played with an angled blade towards point.
Back of a length outside off, punched towards covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes punches it to deep cover for a single. 150 partnership up for Stokes and Duckett. They are taking the game away from Bangladesh.
Full length ball at the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Amazing shot! Stokes had been brilliant today. Fullish delivery angled in from around the wicket, Stokes reverse sweeps it through the fine leg region for a boundary.
On a length outside off, punched towards covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
What a repreive for Duckett! Flighted delivery, Duckett kneels and sweeps it aerially towards square leg. Mosharraf who is stationed there dives to his left and puts down a straight forward chance.
Tossed up on a length around off, Stokes stays back and punches it through mid off for a single.
Duckett drives it with the spin through mid off for a single.
FOUR! Good improvisation. Tossed up on middle, Duckett gets into position early and brings out the fancy reverse sweep and the ball flies behind the square leg region and through to the boundary.
Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, driven down the ground.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

In the air.. but safe! An off cutter once again which is fullish in length around leg stump, Duckett bends and tries to heave it but gets a top edge which goes into the air towards backward square leg. There are a couple of fielders who run in and the keeper also comes in but the ball falls in no man's land.
Lovely delivery! Off cutter from Mortaza which pitches outside leg, Duckett looks to defend but the ball cuts sharply and beats him through to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, Ben camps back and punches it to long off for a single.
On a length directed at the stumps from around the wicket, Stokes covers the line well and defends stoutly.
Full around middle and leg. Stokes lunges forward and eases it wide of mid on for a single. 200 up for England and they are playing really well.
Duckett drives the flighted delivery through mid on for a single.
Fullish ball around leg stump, Duckett kneels and sweeps it aerially to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Stokes clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery around leg stump, Stoke advances down and looks to hit it down the ground but gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg.
FOUR! That's whacked! Tossed up on a length on middle, Stokes makes room and drills it through the covers for a superb boundary.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN is back on.

That's Drinks. What a passage of play for England. This stand is worth 128 and it has come at around 6 an over. The hosts have dropped a couple of catches and that has certainly not helped them. They no need to brace themselves against a hurricane now.
On middle and leg, tucked through square leg again for a run.
Maiden ODI Fifty up for Duckett.

There it comes! Half century on debut for Duckett. A length ball around middle, worked through square leg for one. Duckett raises his bat to the crowd and the dressing room. It has been an impressive knock.
Around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single. That is the impressive thing in this partnership. Boundary followed by a single.
Jumps down the track but the length is a bit short and he is forced to push it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Ho ho! What a shot, what a shot! This guy is special. That is such a tough shot to play. Perhaps it was a slower delivery but that doesn't make the shot any easier. The length is a bit short and Stokes reverse scoops it over short third man for a boundary! Makes it look so easy, as if he has lot of time. Stokes moves to 80 from 75 balls.
Good change of pace around off, pushed straight to point.
Very full outside off, squeezed to point where the fielder slides to his left but the ball goes through. A run taken.
A good length ball around middle, good upright seam position, BD hops and punches it to cover for a single. The stand is worth 120 from 122 balls.

Good fielding in the deep. A short ball angled across the left-hander, Ben pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball races away but Imrul Kayes covers good distance to his right in the deep and dives to prevent the boundary. Two runs taken.
Around middle and leg, gently nudged through square leg for a run.
Fuller to Stokes, the line is the same, chipped to short mid-wicket.
A good bumper, short and around leg, Duckett swivels and pulls it beautifully through square leg for a single.
Down the leg side, turned fine for a couple.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Good from Duckett, gives the strike back to the current Midas for England. Pushes it through the covers and takes a run.

DROPPED AGAIN! Stokes is leading a charmed life. A length ball outside off, Stokes comes down the track and looks to go over the top. He gets a thick top edge which flies in the air. Mosharraf Hossain comes running in from sweeper cover but loses the ball in the sky. He stutters but then recovers to get to the ball. Still, he drops it. The batsmen take the single.
Full on middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
A short ball, pulled away for a run. The stand is worth 110 from 110 balls.
Around middle and off, defended to the off side.
Landed around off, Ben looks to steer it to third man but is squared up a touch and the ball runs off the edge to third man. A single taken. Moves to 70 from 64 balls.

IN... AND OUT! DROPPED! How costly is this going to prove? Full on middle, Stokes comes down the track and looks to hit it over the top but the ball hits the toe end of the bat. It goes low to Mahmudullah at mid on who comes across, takes the catch but somehow, the ball pops out. Robert Key on air informs that Bangladesh dropped 5 catches in 3 matches against Afghanistan recently. Well, that bad habit is not leaving them.
Landed outside off, steered behind point. The fielder runs quickly to his right to stop the ball.
WIDE. A wayward ball. Short and down the leg side, Stokes looks to pull but misses. Mushfiqur Rahim does well to dive to his right to stop the ball.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Wide outside off, punched behind point for a run.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Landed around middle, defended back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched straight to short extra cover.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Mashrafe Mortaza comes back to bowl.
Full toss outside off, BS looks to drive it through the covers but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to fine leg. A run taken.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
100 partnership up for Duckett and Stokes.
FOUR! Thrash! Full and on middle, Stokes hammers this straight back and poor Taskin gets out of harm's way.
Through him. What a jaffa. On a good length around middle, Stokes looks to work it to the leg side but the ball nips back in and goes over the stumps.
Full and wide outside off, Duckett reaches out to drive it through mid off. Sabbir Rahman comes charging in but fumbles and the otherwise close single is easily completed.
A short ball around middle, pulled down to long leg for a single.

FOUR! That is good batting. There are two men saving one on the off side at point and short third man but no one in the deep. Duckett gets down, brings out the reverse sweep and hits it over short third man for a boundary. 13 from the over, Duckett moves to 41 from 54 balls.
Fuller on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, BS cuts it through the covers. The fielder at short extra gets a hand to it but is unable to stop it and the ball goes through. Two runs taken.
Landed around middle, defended towards covers.
Full and wide outside off, Ben reaches out and pushes it to point.
SIX! What a shot. Flighted around middle, Stokes dances down the track and hits this miles over long on!
Around off, Duckett looks to pull but misses.
Full and around off, BD drives hard but mistimes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Cheeky! Nice improvisation. A length ball around leg and middle, Duckett gets across and scoops it over the keeper to the fine leg fence. Nick Knight on air says that Duckett plays this shot quite a few times in county cricket.
Around middle and off, well defended.
Short and outside off, Duckett slashes hard but misses.
Landed around middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
7th ODI fifty for Stokes.

FOUR! Half century for Stokes. Brings it up in style as well. Full and around middle, Stokes gets down and reverse sweeps it through point to get a boundary. It has been a calculated knock. Not many thought he would do well in these conditions but he has impressed. He came in when his side was in trouble and has taken his ship into calmer waters.
Full and down the leg side, Ben misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Landed around off, defended watchfully.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Mahmudullah comes on to bowl.
FOUR! Ends the over in poor fashion. Down the leg side, Stokes just helps it to the fine leg fence. Taskin is not happy with himself. 5 good balls, only to be followed by a poor one.
Outside off, steered to third man for a single.
A good sharp bouncer, around middle and leg, Duckett just sways out of harm's away. The ball whizzes past his helmet.
Around middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
This one slants across the left-hander from middle, Duckett has a waft but misses.
On middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Taskin Ahmed introduced into the attack.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Around middle and leg, Ben goes back and works it through square leg for a run.

SIX! Not cleanly hit but he will get a maximum. Tossed up around off, Stokes comes down the track and swings hard but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Still he goes through with his shot and skies this high in the air. Deep mid-wicket thinks he has a chance but then reality is something different. The ball sails over him into the boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Landed outside off, Duckett looks to play the slog sweep but gets an inner edge back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point for a quick single.
Landed outside off, pushed down to long on for a single. The stand is worth 60 from 63 balls. Excellent counter-attacking.
Full and outside off, well blocked.
FOUR! Another quality shot. Full and around off, Stokes gets down and reverse sweeps it over point for a boundary! A little bit of pressure on the hosts now.
Full and outside off, defended towards covers.
FOUR! Take that! Dragged short around middle, Stokes goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Moves to 30 from 33 balls.
Around middle, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Comes down the track and pushes it down to long on for one. 11 from the over.
Around middle and leg, defended to the leg side.
50 partnership up for Duckett and Stokes.
Full and around middle, pushed down to long on for a run. This has been an excellent partnership. Great recovery.
Cheeky from Duckett, gets down and across and gently laps it over the keeper to fine leg for a couple. Big risk in that shot.
Expectedly flatter ball down the leg side, Ben goes back and works it fine for a single.
SIX! Spanked! Terrific batting. Full and on middle, Stokes gets down and slog sweeps this over square leg for a biggie! Moves to 24 from 28 balls.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Pushes this through the covers for a run.
Comes down the track and looks to defend but is not to the pitch of the ball and it lobs off his pads towards the bowler.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, Duckett looks to sweep but misses and the ball hits his helmet.
Pushes this through mid off for a single.

A close LBW call. Full and around leg, Duckett looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Mosharraf appeals but umpire turns it down. The bowler smiles, but is not sure about the review. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be going over the top.
Fuller length this time, quietly worked through square leg for another single. 100 UP FOR ENGLAND. That dressing room will be a bit relieved now.
Flatter delivery around leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length, Stokes goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, defended from the crease.
Mosharraf Hossain comes into the attack.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Down the leg side, Ben misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Around middle, Duckett looks to tuck it to the leg side but is squared up and defends awkwardly.
Pushes this down to long on for a single.
Full and just outside off, quietly defended this time.
SIX! Smoked! He saw that very early. Dropped short around middle, Stokes rocked back in a flash and pulled it mightily over mid-wicket. Moves to 13 from 18 balls. The stand is worth 33 from 34 balls.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off, Duckett comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary! Duckett is getting better and better with this innings.
Full on middle, this time Ben reverse sweeps it to deep point for a single.
Full on middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.

Very risky from Stokes. Full and straight, Stokes looks to sweep and just about gets a bottom edge as the ball rolls down to fine leg. There is a good stop at the boundary which keeps the batsmen to a couple.
Follows the batsman, bowls it down the leg side, Ben goes back and is cramped for room, Ends up punching it back to the bowler.
The batsman has taken the risk and lofted it over the covers. Two runs added to the total.
FOUR! Smash! Impressive from the debutant. Full and outside off, Duckett gets down and slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fractionally between short and full, punched straight to short extra cover.
Shorter in length outside off, cut straight to point this time.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers where a diving stop prevents runs.

Not Out! Arm ball from Shakib outside off, Stokes prods forward to defend but the quicker pace on the ball does him and it beats the outside edge of his bat and whizzes through to the keeper. He collects it well and flicks the bails off appealing for a stumping. It is referred to the TV umpire. The replays show that the back leg of Stokes was planted in the crease at the time of stumping. The on field call stays and Ben survives.
There is a stumping appeal against Stokes and it is referred upstairs.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, Duckett advances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up delivery outside off, holding its line. Duckett extends his arms and lifts it over mid off and the ball rolls through to the boundary.
Tossed up around leg stump, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Stokes drives it through mid on for a single.
Quick through the air on middle, Stokes comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Slow through the air on off, Stokes is solid in his defence.
A tad short on the pads, Stokes looks to flick it but misses and is struck on the pads.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Stokes lunges forward in defence.
Quicker through the air at the stumps, Stokes stays back and defends.
Straying on the pads, Stokes works it towards the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Duckett comes forward and drives it through the covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, Duckett prods forward and defends it with an angled bat towards covers.
A tad short outside off, Stokes camps back and cuts it behind point for a single.
On a length outside off, Stokes stays back and punches it towards covers.

Sabbir is everywhere! A short ball around middle, Duckett pulls this over mid-wicket. The ball does not quite have the legs to reach the fence and Rahman races to the boundary, dives, pulls the ball back in and himself tumbles over the ropes. Three runs taken.
MAHMUDULLAH comes on to bowl now.
The batsman plays the Square Cut. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, defended towards short mid-wicket.
BEN STOKES walks in at number 5, replacing Bairstow.

OUT! Sabbir is turning it around in the field! Tossed up around off, Bairstow lunges forward and drives it towards mid off and sets off for a single. Sabbir is quick  to get to the ball and hurls in a direct throw at the non-striker's end. Bairstow puts in a full fledged dive to get back but he seems to have not made it. It is referred upstairs for a run out. The home side look condident. The replays show that Bairstow was way out of his crease and the on field call stays. Bangladesh are jubilant and are on top.
Direct hit! Bairstow looks to be in a big pool of trouble. It is referred upstairs....
Full delivery, Bairstow tries to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Full around middle and leg, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Full outside off, driven towards the covers.
A tad short outside off, Duckett opens the face of the bat and guides it behind point for a couple.
Duckett drives it with the spin towards mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
JONNY BAIRSTOW walks in at number 4, replacing Roy.

OUT! The dangerous Roy departs! Slow through the air and tossed up around middle and leg, Roy dances down the track and lifts it high into the sky towards long off. Sabbir positions himself under it and pouches it safely.
Tossed up on a length outside off, Roy stays back and punches it towards covers.
Flighted delivery, Duckett prods forward and defends.
A bit flatter this time, Roy stays back and plays it with an angled blade behind point for a single.
Tossed up, tucked towards the on side.
SIX! That's whacked over mid-wicket for a maximum. Tossed up on off, Roy kneels and slog sweeps it aerially over deep mid-wicket and the ball clears the boundary easily.
Tossed up on a length outside off, Roy camps back and punches it towards the covers.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN into the attack now. More spin. Mid off drops back.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. Four fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Short of a length outside off, Duckett camps back and cuts it through the point region for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Duckett taps it towards the point region.

On a length around off, Roy drives it towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder hurls in a throw at the no striker's end and hits it. Roy seemed to be have made the ground in time but the umpire still refers it upstairs for a run out. Shakib looks confident out there. But the replays show that Roy had made it safely. The on field call stays.
A direct hit! Is Roy in trouble? Referred upstairs...
FOUR! Crafty from Roy! Fullish delivery angling into the stumps, Roy waits for it and manufactures a late cut through the vacant slip region and the ball races to the fence.
Full delivery directed at the stumps, pushed back to bowler.
Back of a length ball outside off, Roy stays back and defends it towards the covers.
Tossed up around off, Roy stays back and punches it to long off for a single.
Roy kneels fetching it from outside off as he sweeps it behind square leg.
Duckett drives it playing with the angle through mid on for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit quicker through the air outside off, Duckett stays back and shapes for the cut but gets beaten.
Tossed up outside off, Duckett stays back to punch but the low bounce on the ball does him and he gets a bottom edge.
Fullish delivery around off, coming in. Roy drives it hard and the bowler dives to his right on the follow through and makes a good save.

FOUR! Loose from the fielder at backward point. Short and wide outside off, Roy cuts it hard and the ball goes through towards the left of the fielder as he fails to save it and through to the boundary.
That was hit so hard! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Vince extends his arms and drills it towards the cover region but fails to pierce the gap.
On a length on off, Roy camps back and defends.
Big moment for the debutant. BEN DUCKETT comes in at number 3, replacing Vince.

OUT! Vince throws his wicket away! Fullish delivery around middle and off, Vince steps down the track as the bat turns in his hand while he attemps to loft it down the ground. The ball catches the inner half of his bat and lobs towards Mortaza at mid on. He is under it and grabs it safely. Crucial breakthrough for Bangladesh.
On a length outside off, Vince covers the line well and pushes it gently towards mid off.
Loopy delivery around middle, Vince bends and sweeps it nicely behind square leg for a single. Good over for England as they got 9 runs from it.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Slow through the air on middle, Roy goes inside out and hits it aerially over the covers region for a couple.
Full around off, driven through mid off for a single.

Beautiful shot and good footwork from Sabbir in the field. Flighted ball around middle, Vince extends his arms and lifts it over the cover region and Sabbir is nimble on his feet as he keeps the ball in play and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Tossed up around middle, Vince steps down the track and lifts it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
On a length outside off, Roy stays back and tries to punch it through covers but gets beaten.
Fullish length ball outside off, Vince strides forward and plays it with soft hands towards mid off and scampers through for a quick single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.

The skipper leads from the front in the field. Full length delivery just outside off, Roy lunges and drives it on the up firmly towards mid on. Mortaza who is stationed there dives athletically to his left and makes a brilliant save. Keeps the batsmen down to one.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven towards the cover region.
On a length outside off, Vince goes for a cut but gets a thick outside edge through the vacant slip region for a single.
FOUR! Inventive from Roy! Flighted delivery around off, Roy reverse sweeps it behind point and the ball races to the fence.
Slower through the air outside off, Vince comes down to the pitch of the ball and drives it sweetly through the covers for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, Vince prods forward in defence.
Quicker through the air this time, Vince stays back and defends.
Full around middle, Roy clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, Roy comes forward and pushes it towards the covers.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into bowl.
Fullish delivery just outside off, Vince prods forward and defends solidly.
Fullish length ball outside off, Roy drives on the up and gets a thick outside edge that flies through the slip region for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Roy plays a square cut towards the point region.
Fullish delivery just outside off, Roy doesn't get it from the meat of the bat as he lifts it just over the fielder at mid off and comes back for a couple.
On a length wide outside off, Roy tries to cut it fiercely but misses it completely.
In the air, but safe! Fullish delivery fired in on the stumps, Roy shapes and goes for the flick but gets a leading edge towards mid off.
Back of a length ball outside off, Roy taps it through the point region for a single.
FOUR! Brave shot from Roy. Off cutter from Mortaza this time, Roy takes a couple of steps down the track and lifts it beautifully over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish delivery around middle and off, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot! On a length outside off, Roy stands tall and punches it with sheer timing through the covers and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
Fullish delivery around off, Roy lunges forward and defends solidly.
Length delivery just outside off, coming in. Vince nudges it nicely through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length directed at the stumps, Roy tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball outside off, Vince chops it through the point region for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish delivery, tailing in. Vince drives it gently towards mid off. There is a bit of a fumble from the fielder but the batsmen decide not to go for the run.
On a length outside off, Vince is not bothered to play at that one.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Overpitched outside off, Vince extends his arms and creams it through the cover region for a gorgeous boundary.
Shafiul Islam to take the new ball from the other end.
In the corridor of uncertainty outside off, shaping in. Roy shuffles and takes a couple of steps down the track and tries to flick but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
Length delivery outside off, Roy lets it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, Roy taps it down towards point.
Fine leg comes in while square leg goes to the deep.
Poor shot from Roy. Fullish length delivery outside off, swinging away. Roy has a wild heave at it down the ground and fails to connect
Length delivery directed at the stumps, Vince covers the line well and nudges it towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Similar delivery, Roy drives it away from his body at this time and finds the gap in the cover region. Sabbir gives a good chase and restricts them to three.
Wide. On a length wide outside off swinging away, Roy leaves it alone. Wide signaled by the umpire.

The players are out in the middle. It promises to be an exciting contest between bat and ball. Jason Roy and James Vince come out to bat. The skipper Mashrafe Mortaza to start the proceedings for Bangladesh.

ENGLAND TEAM COMPOSITION - The visitors have gone in with a proper spinner in Adil Rashid and a part-timer in Moeen Ali. They have four seamers in David Willey, Chris Woakes, Jake Ball and Ben Stokes. No Plunkett, which is a bit of a surprise.

BANGLADESH TEAM COMPOSITION - Interesting ploy from the home side. They have not gone in with any specialist spinner. Shakib, Mahmudullah, Mosaddek and Mosharraf can all bowl spin but excluding Shakib, none is a proper spinner. All are part-timers. The pace attack will be shared by Mashrafe Mortaza, Taskin Ahmed and Shafiul Islam.

Having said that, winter is approaching. So, one might see a lot of dew in the evening. Not to end up speaking on both sides of the coin, but Mortaza may not feel bad to chase on this wicket, if it is a reasonable target.

TOSS - The spin of the coin has been done and England have got a head start. Normally, on turning tracks, one would like to set a target and Jos Buttler has done exactly that. ENGLAND HAVE ELECTED TO BAT FIRST.

It is going to be a different challenge for this new-look England side. Firstly, the man who inspired the changed look, Eoin Morgan is not playing. Secondly, their last Asian tour was in 2014, when they were defeated by Sri Lanka. Jos Buttler is going to have his hands full because one expects turning tracks.

There have been plenty of talks regarding this series. Perhaps England are looking at this as a small stop before their big tour of India. But the hosts have plenty to play for. They are on a streak of 6 consecutive ODI series wins at home, having last lost to India in 2014. Post that, they have beaten Zimbabwe(twice), Pakistan, India, South Africa and recently, Afghanistan. Also, they have lost just 3 out of 20 matches at home. Brilliant record.

The sun is shining brightly in Dhaka, putting aside all fears of a thunderstorm. This day might never have come. But it has. The security concerns have been taken care of and we are ready for England's tour of Bangladesh. Hello and a warm welcome to the first of the 3-match ODI series.
